text: The landing replaces three dump calls with console.error and removes the obsolete console-service TODO. It retains the unknown-flag loop's i += 2, which skips the following argument, and leaves both catch blocks' continuation behavior intact. This addresses the diagnostic sink without implementing the reporter's requested immediate exit or nonzero exit status. Source inspection does not establish terminal delivery or all-release console visibility.
title: Unknown command-line warnings change sink while argument handling continues
